discoveries.finding: The architecture requires AstrologyHOMM8.AstrologyPointResource_id and InsightResource_id, but the shared Resource catalog lacks parents for native astrology_exp and starDust. The official initial Cargo pages prove those source IDs existed on 2026-05-13, while the retained build-25061458 spell extractor also reads starDust costs.
discoveries.impact: AstrologyHOMM8 cannot satisfy its FKs without adding source-backed shared Resource and GameResource parents or changing the model.

discoveries.finding: AstrologyHOMM8 requires a unique NeutralMagicSchool_id, while the retained build extractor deliberately creates only Daylight, Nightshade, Arcane and Primal schools and leaves neutral spells without an invented fifth school.
discoveries.impact: Do not fabricate a neutral-school parent. Reconcile the schema requirement with the actual source model before inserting AstrologyHOMM8.

discoveries.finding: Official Cargo indices are game-derived, but the accessible initial revisions are dated 2026-05-13 and the current CargoCoverage page says it represents the latest extract.
discoveries.impact: Native IDs can corroborate identity continuity; current numerical balance and ability membership cannot be asserted as build 25061458 without a matching revision or retained raw source.

discoveries.finding: Official game-data revisions for Angel and Archangel are dated 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-02 and expose native active/passive ability IDs. These dates closely flank the 2026-09-29 target snapshot, but the pages do not state the source Steam build.
discoveries.impact: This is a viable low-download source for creature ability identities once its extraction revision is tied to build 25061458. It is not yet sufficient to populate all 146 creatures or required ability mechanics.

discoveries.finding: The official Angel article revision from 2026-08-06 predates the target and its six retained combat values match build 25061458 exactly (225 HP, 30 Attack, 30 Defense, 50-75 Damage, 8 Initiative, 4 Speed). Its active/passive and attack/movement mechanics are therefore strongly aligned for this sampled creature.
discoveries.impact: The official wiki can support source-backed creature abilities without a full game download, but the sample does not establish version alignment for every unit or justify bulk inference.
